name: Identity Inventory
summary: Janus — finds human, service/NHI and machine identities by content (local-user enumeration plugins + output), classified by external authority (Microsoft well-known SIDs/RIDs, AD $ accounts, Linux UID convention). Metrics for inventory, credential coverage, account hygiene (privileged, account reuse, never-expiring, SSH passwords) and priority (privileged on exploitable hosts, KEV, crown jewels). Tags the hosting assets: Identity, NHI, Machine ID, Owner, Identity Risk, Identity Coverage (gated), plus natural-language tagging.
